narrative.overview: The page is a weather map at night. The temperature you type picks an isotherm band, and the whole page takes a very dark shade of that band; the three numbers glow in the band's own colour. A legend strip along the foot shows the full ramp with a marker at your value.
keyCharacteristics: Ground and figures follow the current value's 10 °C band; ten bands plus "empty" and "below absolute zero".
Huge condensed tabular figures; the input is the output.
Three fields of equal weight side by side on desktop, stacked on phone.
Legend strip with a value marker anchors the colour to a scale.

rules.name: The Whole Page Moves Rule
rules.body: Ground, figure, label and rule switch together, always from the same band.

rules.name: The Key Rule
rules.body: The colour always has a key: the legend strip is on every state that has a value.

rules.name: The Raw Band Rule
rules.body: Raw band colours appear only in the legend. Never set text in a raw cold band colour.

dos: Do copy the band-role block from design/mockups/tokens.css as is and switch bands with one data-band attribute on <body>.
Do keep all three figures the same size, chosen from the longest value.
Do keep the notice slot reserved even when empty.
Do self-host Barlow and Barlow Condensed next to index.html.
donts: Don't add boxes, cards, shadows, rounded corners or buttons; the fields are bare figures on a rule.
Don't set text in the raw cold band colours.
Don't show an error popup or red error styling for non-numeric input; the other fields just clear.
Don't add a light theme or a theme toggle; the dark shade is the design.
